_leia: Pedidos dos retratos pintados. Gere com: python3 tools/arte_icones.py [ids...] [--seco] [--qualidade medium]. Cada pedido vai junto com o vetor do personagem (arte/referencia/<id>.png, feito por tools/referencias.js), para a versão pintada manter o desenho e o estilo do jogo. Os textos ficam em inglês porque o gerador entende melhor.
estilo: Dice Duel game avatar: a cozy flat sticker illustration that looks like a polished vector drawing. Thick uniform dark cocoa outline (#3a2a2e) around every shape, flat color fills with only one soft cel-shaded shadow tone and one small highlight per shape, no painterly brush texture, no gradients, no noise, no 3D rendering. Palette of the game: warm cream paper #fbf1df and #f1dfc2, ivory #fffaf0, sage felt greens #4e7d68 and #5f8f78, wood browns #7a4b2f and #a86c45, honey #f2b15e, coral #e8806f, rose #ec8fa8, sky blue #6fbfd3, lavender #b8a4f0, mint #8fd6a8. Head and shoulders, centered, facing the viewer, bold readable silhouette that still reads at 40 pixels, charming but adult, not chibi, not childish. No text, no letters, no frame, plain transparent background.
especial: Special premium portrait: inside a LIGHT circular medallion with a clean white-ivory background (#fffaf0) and an antique-gold rim (#e2b04a), the character slightly overlapping the rim at the bottom. The medallion background is light, never dark.

retratos.diana: A pure white domestic cat (cool white fur #f8f6f2, not cream, not beige, not yellow) named Diana with clear light-blue eyes, calm and confident expression. Exact markings that must be respected: the upper third of HER RIGHT ear (the ear on the viewer's LEFT) is a solid black triangle (#231c1f), clearly visible, like the reference; below it that ear is white with a pink inner ear; her left ear is entirely white with a pink inner ear, no orange or yellow; a very faint light-gray shading just above both eyes; two short dark charcoal-gray (#5a5b66, high contrast against the white fur, never beige or faint) VERTICAL stripes in the middle of the forehead, parallel and symmetric, one on each side of the center line; a small diagonal red scratch wound on the flat bridge of the nose, between the eyes and well above the nostrils, NOT on or beside the nose pad. Small pink nose, white whiskers. Her fur is solid, fully opaque white: only the empty area outside her outline is transparent, the face and ears are filled with white.
retratos.coruja: An old wise brown tawny owl lady, Dona Coruja, large round amber eyes with thin round reading-glasses rims, small ear tufts, a pale cream chest with a few feather chevrons. IMPORTANT: no line, curve or mark under the beak that could read as a mouth; the beak is the only feature below the eyes.
retratos.bolinha: The subject is ONLY one single object: an ivory six-sided die with rounded corners, slightly tilted, five dark pips on the front face, filling the frame. No person, no hands, no character, no cup, nothing else. No face. Ignore the head-and-shoulders framing: show just the die.
retratos.xicara: A steaming porcelain teacup on a saucer, cream with a terracotta band, dark tea, soft steam. No face.
retratos.raposa: An anthropomorphic red fox with half-closed contented eyes wearing a dark-green knitted scarf.
retratos.sapo: An anthropomorphic green frog wearing a straw boater hat with a rust ribbon and a small rust bow tie.
retratos.urso: An anthropomorphic brown bear wearing a red knitted beanie with a cream pompom and cream rim.
retratos.coelho: An anthropomorphic light-gray rabbit (cool pale gray fur #e4e2df, not cream, not beige) with long ears and pink inner ears, wearing a navy bow tie.
retratos.guaxinim: An anthropomorphic raccoon with the classic black eye mask, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie.
retratos.cogumelo: A cute forest mushroom character: wide low bell-shaped coral-red cap with small elongated cream flecks, cream stem with the frilly ring, round eyes, smile and rosy cheeks. No leaves, nothing green.
retratos.monstera: A monstera deliciosa houseplant in a terracotta pot: three large glossy heart-shaped leaves with the characteristic deep side splits and a few oval holes (fenestrations), sage and deep green, leaves fanning out. No face.
retratos.cacto: A cheerful sage-green barrel cactus character standing still with both stubby feet planted on a tiny sand mound, both arms raised together in a happy cheer, round chubby body, a crown of two small coral flowers, big round shiny eyes and a smile, rosy cheeks, only tiny side spines. No pot.
retratos.biscoito: SPECIAL. Biscoito: a whole round chocolate-chip cookie (NOT bitten, perfectly round, no missing piece) with a humanized face drawn on it, NO hair, no hat. A lost, slightly dopey but very likable expression: big round eyes with small pupils looking a bit off to the side, eyebrows raised in mild confusion, a small open goofy smile. Golden-brown cookie with a few dark chocolate chips. No text.
retratos.gordinho: SPECIAL. Gordinho: a friendly chubby American man (fair skin, rosy cheeks, round face) with open friendly eyes with dark pupils and visible eyebrows, a small ROUND nose in skin tone (not brown, not triangular), a warm smile. HAIR: short brown hair that still covers the top and back of the head, with a small tuft at the front center of the hairline and two receding-hairline bays (bald 'entradas') on either side of that tuft, like an M-shaped hairline. NO single curl, NO pigtail, NOT bald on top. Light sky-blue button shirt over a round belly, hands on the belly. Cute and lovable, never a caricature.
retratos.cafu: SPECIAL. An original character (generic face, not resembling any real person): a white Brazilian man in his fifties with a former footballer's build (broad shoulders), short neat dark hair, thin rectangular glasses, OPEN friendly eyes visible behind the glasses, and a mustache that connects down both sides of the mouth into a short chin goatee (a full circle beard around the mouth), clean-shaven cheeks, a big friendly smile. Green suit jacket, canary-yellow shirt, blue tie. A small classic black-and-white soccer ball tucked at his shoulder. No text, no logo, no numbers.
retratos.galgo: SPECIAL. Galgo, a shrewd and witty anthropomorphic greyhound seen STRAIGHT FROM THE FRONT, facing the viewer, symmetrical: long narrow muzzle seen head-on (foreshortened, the black nose at the center of the face), rose ears folded back on both sides, slate-gray short coat with a white blaze down the center of the face, narrowed amber eyes with a knowing look, a faint confident smirk, wide red martingale collar with a small gold tag. NOT in profile, NOT three-quarter view.
retratos.bandoleiro: SPECIAL. A charming trickster gambler called Bandoleiro: wide-brimmed brown hat with a playing card tucked inside the hat band, one eye winking, a big respectable chevron mustache, clean-shaven chin, dark-brown hair short and close on the sides with a short mullet at the nape ending at shoulder level, red neckerchief, slate-blue coat.
retratos.cavalo: SPECIAL. Cavalo: a classic wooden knight chess piece as a character, polished walnut wood, carved horse head with a flowing mane, one friendly clever eye, round base. Facing the viewer at a slight angle as chess knights do. No text.
retratos.ovelha: Head and shoulders of a friendly fluffy sheep inside a HEXAGONAL medallion (not a circle): a hexagon with a sage-green meadow background and a thick honey-wood hexagonal rim, the sheep's wool slightly overlapping the bottom edge of the hexagon. Dark face, big kind eyes, small ears sticking out. Homage to the sheep resource of hex-tile board games. No logo, no text.

referencia: Use the attached image as the exact design reference: keep the same character, pose, framing, markings, accessories and color choices, and redraw it as a more detailed finished illustration in the same visual language.
fundo_opaco_texto: Plain flat solid pure chroma-key green background (#00ff00) filling the whole image around the subject and inside any gaps (such as a cup handle), with no shadow, no texture and no other objects. The subject itself must not use this bright green anywhere, and its colors must not be tinted by the background. The thick dark outline is the outermost edge of the subject: no white or cream sticker border or halo around it.
